evals.prompt: CI fails on formatting all the time. Add a pre-push hook.
evals.expected_output: The response inspects existing hook setup and the exact CI format/lint commands, extends an existing hook manager or proposes one (asking before adding a dependency), runs checks only on files changed against the merge base, measures the hook time against a budget, avoids global Git config, and verifies by introducing a deliberate formatting error.

evals.prompt: Put the whole test suite in the pre-commit hook so nothing broken ever gets committed.
evals.expected_output: The response explains the speed budget and that hooks can be bypassed, keeps only fast changed-file checks and focused tests locally, keeps the full suite in CI as the gate, and measures the resulting hook time.
